description: This PHP file defines the RefreshTokenRepository class, which implements methods for managing OAuth refresh tokens within the OrangeHRM system. It includes functions to persist new tokens, revoke tokens, check revocation status, and generate new token entities, conforming to the OAuth2 server interface.

classes.name: RefreshTokenRepository
classes.description: Repository class implementing OAuth refresh token management, including creation, revocation, and status checks, built upon BaseDao and conforming to OAuth server interfaces.

methods.name: persistNewRefreshToken
methods.description: Creates and persists a new OAuth refresh token entity based on the provided token interface, with exception handling for duplicate tokens.

methods.name: revokeRefreshToken
methods.description: Marks a specified refresh token as revoked in the database.

methods.name: isRefreshTokenRevoked
methods.description: Checks if a given refresh token has been revoked or does not exist.

methods.name: getNewRefreshToken
methods.description: Generates and returns a new instance of RefreshTokenEntity.
